title: Largest Perimeter Triangle
description: Given an integer array nums, return the largest perimeter of a triangle with a non-zero area, formed from three of these lengths.

steps.note: Sort array in descending order to easily find the largest sides.
Check if 6 < 3 + 3. It is not (6 is not < 6).
Check if 3 < 3 + 2. It is (3 < 5). Condition met.
